messages:
Samira: Heads up — a courier dropped off a potted succulent by the lobby desk around 5:20pm and left. No sender label and the visitor didn’t grab a badge. :seedling:
Jorge: Oh! Did they leave a delivery slip or a sticker on the pot?
Samira: Nothing. Just the plant in a brown box with a bit of soil. I asked front desk to bag it and put it in the back area.
Frontdesk Bot: package logged — ID 859302 (unlabelled plant). Stored in locker 9. Please claim with "package ID 859302" at desk.
Maya: I walked past — the box says fragile on the side but no team. Could be from the design studio?
Evan: Not sales. We didn’t order anything. I checked Slack DMs from our vendor playlist — nothing.
Lena: Could be for marketing? They had that event this morning. Posting in #marketing now.
Samira: Thanks. Quick ask: can we remind couriers to include "TO: TEAM" on labels? This keeps the front desk from guessing.
Jorge: 100% yes. Also reminder that visitor badges must be printed/collected for any on-site guest. We had a case tonight where the person left without checking in. :eyeglasses:
Maya: Can we add a small printed instruction to the locker: "If unlabelled, log package + set aside for 24h"? It'd speed things up during evening shifts.
Samira: Good idea. If folks agree, I can order a pack of 50 stickers that say: TEAM: ______ and a sticky pad for the courier to use.
Evan: +1 on stickers. Saves the guessing game.
Lena: Also asking marketing — they just replied, nope.
Samira: OK, proposal: 1) Order 50 courier stickers; 2) Add locker signage; 3) Add one-line reminder to visitor check-in bot. Poll: should I order? React with :white_check_mark: for yes, :no_entry_sign: for no.
Jorge: :white_check_mark:
Maya: :white_check_mark:
Evan: :white_check_mark:
Lena: :white_check_mark:
Frontdesk Bot: reminder scheduled — "Please affix team label to packages and collect guest badge at check-in."
Samira: Thanks all. If anyone knows who the plant is for, DM me. Otherwise it’ll stay in locker 9 until tomorrow 5pm. :seedling:
